text: AC5 here changes what four of PAWL-006's six delivered criteria count, so the spec now declares Extends PAWL-006 with a criterion-by-criterion table, per _spec/README.md rule 2. Listing it as Related was a process violation. I assumed nothing is superseded - every PAWL-006 criterion still decides what it decided, and AC4 here fails the changeset outright anyway, so the gate is strictly stricter.
